en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali Majiluwayh (ra) narrated to us from his uncle Muhammad b. Abi’l Qasim from Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah from his father from `Abdullah b. al-Mughira and Muhammad b. Sinan from Talha b. Zayd from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as).
He said: My father (as) would say: There is nothing more corrupting to the heart than sin.
Sin settles in the heart and remains there until it overcomes it, turning it upside down.
